summary: Gate sidebar fixture publication and TypeScript replay with shared schema validation and synthetic public-data checks.

replay.detail: No daemon event replay or persistent state changes.

schema.detail: No database schema or stored format changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Sidebar fixtures must satisfy the shared behavior schema and synthetic identity policy. The existing TypeScript runner invokes the shared gate before replay. Unknown schema keywords and non-public fixture data fail closed; runtime clients and wire contracts are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Development-time validation only; no service interruption or restart is required.

manual.detail: No operator steps. Fixture authors can run node scripts/check-sidebar-fixtures.mjs before publishing changes.

recovery.detail: Correct rejected fixture data to use synthetic identities, or revert the gate and its runner integration together. No state recovery or migration is required.
